questions.question: In Jesus' story of the ten minas, what did the nobleman tell his servants to do with his money while he was away?
In Jesus' story of the ten minas, what message did the nobleman's subjects send after him?

answers.text: They did not want him to rule over them
They wanted him to hurry back home
They wanted his servants put in charge

questions.question: In Jesus' story of the ten minas, what reward did the master give the servant whose mina earned ten more minas?

answers.text: A seat at the king's table

questions.question: In Jesus' story of the ten minas, what did the master say the servant who hid his mina in a cloth could have done with it?

answers.text: Put it in the bank to earn interest
Handed it to a neighbor to keep
Traded it for a small piece of land
